gbm_population_evidence.quote: Prostate Cancers; Breast Cancer; Lung Cancers; Ovarian Cancer; Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM); Pancreas Cancer; Skin Cancer
Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced/metastatic solid cancers.

candidate_evidence.quote: This clinical trial is an adaptive study of a novel vimentin inhibitor in cancers.
A novel hGIIA-Vimentin Inhibitor: Phase I, dose escalation includes 4 increasing doses, 10mg, 30mg, 60mg and 120mg.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Has failed standard of care or refused next line therapy at the present time

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Secondary objective is to characterise the pharmacokinetics of KESONOTIDE™.

role_evidence.quote: Primary objective is to evaluate safety and tolerability of KESONOTIDE™ as a monotherapy in participants with advanced/metastatic solid cancers.

arms: Phase I, Single Arm, dose escalation
2 Arms of selected indication and recommended dose

coder_notes: Basket phase I/II; glioblastoma multiforme named in conditions. Registered 'Dose expansion' intervention is the same drug at recommended doses, not a separate agent. Phase II may be monotherapy or combined with unnamed standard of care. PK planned but sample type not stated. PSA and CA15.3 mentioned only as disease markers for non-GBM cancers, not coded. No IDH or WHO reference, but 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' wording is historical.
